pin: Part A effects are behavioral signatures, not psychological states. Part B scores institutional conditions. Part C is health and does not reuse A or B indicators. Year fixed effects are included because pass 2 found time-structured gaps, not because the bar rose for everyone.

parameters.rolling_ingroup: top 20 by peer review-object volume in the trailing 24 months; unidentified below 20
parameters.attention_event: one per person per PR per day, from review objects, issue comments, and line comments, excluding the author and bots

E1.description: Standardized coefficient of prior merges on getting a peer response within 14 days.

E2.description: Reciprocity index minus the within-year shuffle null.

E3.description: Agreement-share gap after a top-5 merger's first ACK or NACK, minus everyone else.

E4.description: Standardized coefficient of first-year house-term use on first-year merge rate.

E5.description: Standardized coefficient of log participant count on log days to decision.

E6.description: Within-funder review rate minus a within-year shuffle. Requires a person-to-funder ledger.

E7.description: Standardized coefficient of first-comment tone on merge, controlling for later tone.

E8.description: How much more leavers' tone falls in the last six months than matched active contributors.

E9.description: Merge-rate gap, meeting high-priority list minus unlisted, in the meeting era.

E10.description: Next-year participation after NACK-then-merged minus NACK-then-closed. Negative favors a suppression reading.

E11.description: Follow-up correction rate. LOW OBSERVABILITY: deleted comments are absent.

E12.description: In-group coefficient on 90-day return and on no-peer-response, with shared controls. Unmapped to a principle.

P1a_grant_discussion_share.description: Share of inferred merge-right starts with IRC or mailing-list discussion in the prior 30 days.

P1b_entry_wait_cv.description: Coefficient of variation of days from first PR to first merge, by entry cohort.

P2a_gini_provision_ratio.description: Gini of attention given divided by attention received.

P2a_share_ratio_near_one.description: Share of contributors whose given/received ratio is between 0.5 and 2.

P2a_share_ratio_above_one.description: Share with ratio above 1. Reported only: above 1 is not a signed principle.

P2b_merge_review_correlation.description: Correlation between merges received and attention given.

P2c_top5_review_share.description: Share of attention events produced by the top 5 people that year.

P3a_rule_pr_count.description: Count of rule-changing PRs. Identifies the set; it is not a quality score.

P3b_rule_participant_share.description: Unique participants on rule-changing PRs divided by active contributors.

P3c_nonmerger_rule_merge_rate.description: Merge rate of rule-changing PRs whose author had not merged code before.

P4a_self_merge_rate.description: Share of merges in which the author and the merger are the same person.

P4b_zero_independent_attention_share.description: Share of merges with no attention from anyone except the author and the merger.

P4c_nonmaintainer_review_share.description: Share of canonical-maintainer PRs that received attention from a non-maintainer.

P4c_median_independent_reviews.description: Median count of non-maintainer attention events on canonical-maintainer PRs.

P5a_sanction_events.description: Lock, ban, moderation, or access-removal traces. Counts only.

P5b_graduated_share.description: Share of severe traces preceded by a lesser recorded action. Entered only when at least 10 events exist.

P6a_explicit_resolution_share.description: Share of contested PRs that end by merge or by activity within 30 days of closure.

P6a_median_days_contested.description: Median days to a final state on contested PRs.

P6b_recurring_topics.description: Dispute topics present this year that also appear in three or more separate years.

P6c_exit_channels.description: Dated forks and alternative-implementation launches. Not the H7 departure rate.

P7a_funder_hhi.description: Herfindahl index of funders across active contributors.

P7b_alt_impl_mentions.description: Mentions of other implementations and keyword sentiment. Descriptive and sentiment-model dependent.

P8a_subsystem_local_share.description: Per-subsystem local-merge share. Reported in detail. P8c is that mean and is the scored index.

P8b_venue_count.description: Distinct decision venues with activity that year.

P8c_decision_locality.description: Mean across subsystems of merges by that subsystem's frequent reviewers rather than top-level mergers.

H1_active_reviewers_per_pr.description: Distinct reviewers that year per PR opened.

H2_open_stock_per_pr_opened.description: PRs still open at year end, per PR opened that year.

H2_stale_open_per_pr_opened.description: Year-end open PRs older than one year, per PR opened that year.

H3_cohort_active_24m.description: Share of an entry cohort with activity on or after the 24-month mark.

H4_gini_merges.description: Gini of merged-PR counts across people who opened a PR that year.

H4_gini_reviews.description: Gini of attention given across people who authored or reviewed that year.

H5_bus_factor.description: Fewest people accounting for half of that year's merges.

H6_median_days_to_decision.description: Median days from open to merge or close among decided PRs.

H7_exit_rate.description: Attrition-timeline departures that year divided by timeline members active that year.

effects_table.note: P(peer response within 14 days). Peer response is a review object, issue comment, or line comment. Linear probability is not used; this is logistic. Focal is prior merge count.
Coefficient on prior-merges squared in the same logistic model. Positive means each added merge buys more attention than the last.
Log hours to first peer response, among PRs that received one. PRs with no response are in the 14-day model as failures and out of this timing model.
Attention events are one per reviewer per PR per day. The null shuffles reviewer labels within calendar year,  500 times. Index is the share of events matched by the reverse pair within 30 days.

effects_table.effect_size_flag: negligible effect size regardless of p-value
effects_table.note: Top-5 mergers are the trailing 24-month merge-key holders. First ACK or NACK can come from a comment or a review object. Agreement is the share of later ACK/NACK attention in the same direction. PRs with no later stance are excluded.
Negative means the next same-direction review arrives sooner after a top-5 merger speaks first. Cohen's d uses the same sign.

Person-level. House terms: ACK, concept ACK, approach ACK, nit, tACK, utACK, rebase, squash. Entry-year fixed effects stand in for calendar year. Prior merges and in-group are constant for newcomers and drop out.
Retention means any PR or attention event on or after 24 months from the first PR. Right-censored people are excluded.

effects_table.effect_size_flag: negligible effect size regardless of p-value
effects_table.note: Danescu-Niculescu-Mizil accommodation on inline function-word classes. Estimate is the pair-weighted mean of within-year gaps, which is the year control. Cohen's d is the pair-level match rate toward people who had already merged code versus everyone else. Method-dependent: the category lists are an instrument.

Decided PRs only. Open PRs are right-censored and excluded. Positive means more participants, slower decisions. This is not identified as diffusion of responsibility: a harder PR can draw both more people and a longer wait.

Descriptive rate, not a hypothesis test, so it is outside the BH family. Stall means more than 180 days to a decision, or still open after 180 days. Full review means an APPROVED review or an ACK that is not only a concept or approach ACK.
DATA UNAVAILABLE. No person-to-funder assignment.
Decided PRs with a first peer tone and at least one later peer tone. Logistic. Later mean tone is an added control on top of the shared set.

Difference of (last 180 days minus prior baseline). Active contributors are matched on the leaver's end date and need the same two windows. The timeline is the filtered 301-person attrition file, not every GitHub author. A separate 2024-2026 refit is not identified: each leaver is already one window.

Listed means a PR number appeared in an IRC #topic high-priority review window (until the next #topic or 40 minutes) before the PR was decided. Comparison is restricted to PRs opened on or after the first such topic. Priority topics found: 293. PRs listed before decision: 542.
Among merged PRs in the meeting era. Negative means listed PRs merge faster.

Focal is 1 when the NACKed PR later merged and 0 when it closed without merging. Outcome is the reviewer's attention events in the next 365 days. Negative means less participation after a NACK that lost.
Outcome is the reviewer's own decided-PR merge rate in the next year. Events with no decided PR of their own are excluded.

Harsh means a lexicon hit and negative keyword tone. Follow-up means a non-author-of-the-harsh-comment replies within 7 days at tone >= 0, or the PR carries a lock/ban trace. LOW OBSERVABILITY: deleted and redacted comments are absent, so both the harsh set and the correction set are lower bounds.

No peer response means no review object, issue comment, or line comment by someone other than the author. In-group is the trailing-24-month top 20 by review-object volume, unidentified when fewer than 20 reviewers exist. Unidentified is a control, not coded as out-group.

Return means the author has any later PR or attention event within 90 days after the first peer response. Events after the dataset end minus 90 days are excluded. E12 is not mapped to an Ostrom principle.

plain_text_summary:
Commons dynamics, pass 3.
The resource is reviewer attention and merge authority. Effects, principles, and health are separate measurements.
Year fixed effects are on every model because newcomer and in-group outcomes moved differently over time. Pass 2 did not show one bar rising for everyone.

STRONGEST CONFIRMED EFFECTS
Confirmed means: training estimate, q below 0.05 after BH across passes 1-3, same sign in 2024-2026, and not a negligible Cohen's d or a standardized coefficient under 0.2.
  E5_log_participants_on_log_days: 0.8625 (95% CI 0.8405 to 0.8842), q=0.0025, holdout 0.9123641610241966, maps P4
  E12_ingroup_on_no_peer_response: -0.4929 (95% CI -0.5965 to -0.3955), q=0.0025, holdout -0.7384966136645473, maps none
  E7_first_tone_on_merge_given_later_tone: 0.3096 (95% CI 0.2648 to 0.3550), q=0.0025, holdout 0.4819243312796311, maps P6
  E9_listed_on_log_days_to_merge: 0.2506 (95% CI 0.2236 to 0.2780), q=0.0025, holdout 0.07868431625639927, maps P3, P1
  E3_log_hours_to_next_same_direction_top5_minus_other: -0.4707 (95% CI -0.5547 to -0.3832), q=0.0025, holdout -0.5236842516332842, maps P3, P4
  E2_reciprocity_excess: 0.0238 (95% CI 0.0226 to 0.0250), q=0.0049, holdout 0.02383884781678445, maps P2, P4

WEAKEST PRINCIPLE BY PERIOD (bitcoin/bitcoin)
  2010-2015: weakest P8 (0.18). P1=0.67, P2=0.31, P3=0.32, P4=0.49, P6=0.74, P8=0.18
  2016-2021: weakest P6 (0.37). P1=0.62, P2=0.51, P3=0.53, P4=0.69, P6=0.37, P8=0.39
  2022-2026: weakest P6 (0.37). P1=0.60, P2=0.81, P3=0.49, P4=0.75, P6=0.37, P8=0.60
  P5 and P7 are unscored in every period: sanction traces are below 10 and there is no person-to-funder ledger.

ASSOCIATED WITH LATER HEALTH (low power, about 16 years)
  Principle: P8 spearman -0.717 with health at t+1 (n=13, p=0.006).
  Effect: E2 spearman -0.802 with health at t+1 (n=13, p=0.001).
These lagged tests are descriptive. The cross-repo comparison below is the sturdier contrast.

CROSS-REPO RANKING
Ordered by shared-indicator health, then shared-indicator principles. Shared means entry-wait variation, scope disputes, recurring topics, backlog, 24-month retention, merge Gini, bus factor, and median time to decision. Repos with fewer than 7 years are listed after the ranking and are not treated as leaders. bitcoin/bitcoin is the only full Ostrom profile; its review, monitoring, and exit indicators are not in this rank.

WHAT THIS CANNOT PROVE
  (1) Psychological states are not observable. The effects are behavioral signatures only.
  (2) Ostrom's principles are correlates of durable commons, not proven causes of these outcomes.
  (3) A series of about 16 years cannot establish causation. Lagged correlations are low power.
  (4) P5, P7, E4b, and E11 rely on thin or model-dependent data. P5 and E11 are low observability because deleted and off-platform sanctions are missing. P7 has no person-to-funder ledger, and its sentiment is a keyword model. E4b depends on the function-word lists.
  (5) Results that fail the 2024-2026 holdout or the Benjamini-Hochberg correction are exploratory.
  (6) A commons can score poorly and still survive for a time on funding or reputation before the health metrics show it.
